snippet.title: BURIED BELOW | Official Trailer | Indie Horror Game
snippet.description:
FREE Demo releasing 7PM CEST May 4, 2026 on Steam and itch.io.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3651890/BURIED_BELOW/

Discord: https://discord.gg/nJzFGWExHQ
Website: https://aurastudios.nl

"An old tape replays your worst memory. Tonight, you take 
control as it plays out. A camping trip. A storm. Your 
girlfriend, gone near an abandoned mine. Scour the forest 
for tools to breach the entrance, but something awaits you 
below. Can you survive and find her in the depths?"

Developed by Aura Studios | Justus
